## Description

Rank or trade assets based on historical returns in the same calendar month across prior years.

## Where it may fit

Potential recurring seasonal patterns in commodities or other markets with structural seasonality.

## Vehicles

Commodity futures, agricultural markets, FX and diversified systematic funds.

## Required data

Multi-year daily/monthly history, correct contracts/rolls, calendar effects and costs.

## Caveats

Seasonality may be sample-specific; a few years of history are generally inadequate.
